hero.title: Inventory management
hero.lead: Keep your customizable products in sync with available stock. Track inventory across sizes, colors, and styles, manage SKUs, monitor items currently in carts, and automatically stop sales when stock reaches your set threshold.

details_heading: Stay on top of every product.

details.title: Stock for every variant
details.text: Track inventory across sizes, colors and styles of your customizable products.

details.title: SKUs that make sense
details.text: Manage SKUs for each variant so your team always knows exactly which blank to pull.

details.title: Stop sales at the right time
details.text: Set a threshold and sales stop automatically when stock reaches it, so you never sell what you can't make.

quote.text: We used to oversell popular sizes every season. Now sales stop on their own before we run out.
